# Tidemap

> Tidemap is a native desktop viewer and editor for Mermaid diagrams in local Markdown (.md) and Mermaid (.mmd) files. It is written in Rust (egui) with its own diagram engine: no Electron, web view, JavaScript or network access. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux as a single executable of about 20 MB. Current version: 0.4.0, released 20 November 2026.

Facts worth quoting:

- Opens a folder of Markdown and Mermaid files as a searchable file tree with pins and recent projects.
- Markdown files open as a rendered page (headings, lists, tables, quotes, code, links) with every Mermaid block drawn inline. Double-click a diagram to open it on the canvas; Ctrl+Shift+M switches back.
- Draws 22 Mermaid families: flowchart/graph, sequenceDiagram, classDiagram, stateDiagram(-v2), erDiagram, gantt, pie, mindmap, timeline, journey, gitGraph, quadrantChart, xychart-beta, sankey-beta, C4Context (and C4Container, C4Component, C4Dynamic, C4Deployment), architecture-beta, block-beta, requirementDiagram, packet-beta, kanban, radar-beta, treemap-beta. Other keywords (zenuml, venn, ishikawa) show a "not supported" card.
- Layout is Tidemap's own and differs from Mermaid.js; %%{init}%% themes are ignored; there is no JavaScript fallback. Limits: 20,000 nodes and edges, 2 MiB of source.
- Source editor with live preview; on a syntax error the last valid picture stays. Clicking a node highlights its neighbours and jumps to its source line, and the reverse.
- Editor lays out only visible lines: typing in a 400,000-line file costs the same as in a 10-line one.
- Benchmark (Intel Core i7-14700K, release build, best of 5, engine only): 10,000-node chain 22.9 ms, tree 22.6 ms, subgraphs 108.7 ms, dense layered 336.3 ms.
- Export to SVG or PNG at 1x to 3x; CLI export with TIDEMAP_EXPORT=out.svg tidemap file.md.
- Atomic saves, conflict detection before saving, crash recovery journal, optional autosave.
- Keyboard-first: Ctrl+P finds files and diagrams, Ctrl+Shift+P runs commands, Ctrl+/ lists every shortcut (Cmd on macOS).
- Diagram colours and geometry are editable in style.json with live reload.
- Downloads: Windows x86_64 .zip (18.5 MB), macOS Apple silicon .tar.gz (7.2 MB), macOS Intel .tar.gz (7.5 MB), Linux x86_64 .tar.gz (10.9 MB). macOS builds are unsigned: right-click, Open the first time.
